name: SLIDE CRAFT
subtitle: PowerPoint & Idea Pitch Deck
description: Showcase your innovative ideas and technical presentation skills using structured slide decks.
rules: Submit a 300-word abstract during registration and the final PPT before the event.
Each team has 5 minutes to present, followed by a 2-minute Q&A session. Slides must be less than 7.
Content must be strictly original; any plagiarism will result in immediate disqualification.
Topic will be provided 2 days before the event.
Participants are responsible for their presentation files; organizers are not liable for technical glitches.
Presentations are evaluated on technical content, clarity, and Q&A performance.

rounds.name: Preliminary Deck Screening
rounds.desc: Initial slide deck review by panel judges.

rounds.name: Final Stage Pitch
rounds.desc: Live presentation followed by jury Q&A.

guidelines: Standard projector and clicker will be provided.
Presenters must report 15 minutes before the allocated slot.

name: CRACK THE CODE
subtitle: Code Craft & Bug Hunter
description: Test your logic and debugging prowess across intense algorithmic challenges and bug fixes.
rules: Round 1 is a written test on code analysis and technical questions.
Inbuilt library should not be used. No gadgets are allowed.
Top 15 scorers advance to the final debugging round on a provided system.
Allowed languages for the final round are C, Java, and Python.
Participation can be individual or in a team of up to 2 members; any form of malpractice leads to disqualification.
Finalists are ranked by problems solved and time taken.
rounds: Round 1: Written Logic Test: MCQs covering syntax, complexity, and output prediction.
Round 2: Live Bug Hunting & Coding: Fix broken code snippets and solve competitive problems.
guidelines: Desktop PCs will be provided with offline compilers.
Use of internet or mobile phones is strictly forbidden.

name: TECH BATTLE
subtitle: Brain Bytes & Rapid Trivia
description: Rapid-fire online technology trivia covering computer fundamentals, latest trends, AI, and IT giants.
rules: Screen sharing or cheating must be strictly restricted.
Questions will cover core CSE/IT domains like programming, networks, databases, and AI.
Hints from the audience are not allowed and may lead to a team's disqualification.
The quiz will consist of multiple formats, including buzzer and rapid-fire rounds.

rounds.name: Round 1: Rapid Fire MCQs
rounds.desc: 30 fast-paced technical questions.

rounds.name: Round 2: Identify the Tech & Buzz
rounds.desc: Audio-visual and logo identification.

rounds.name: Round 3: Grand Finale Showdown
rounds.desc: Buzzer-based tie-breaker and high-difficulty trivia.

guidelines: Ensure stable mobile data or connect to designated campus Wi-Fi.

name: WEB PROMPT
subtitle: Web Design & Generative AI Prompting
description: Craft responsive web pages and generate AI visual assets through precision prompting.
rules: Systems will be provided for all the participants.
In Round 1 landing page will be reviewed; in Round 2 the overall website will be reviewed.
A design theme and required assets will be provided on the spot.
Use any technology stack, but pre-made external templates are forbidden.
The entire web UI must be completed and submitted within the time limit.
Submissions are judged on UI/UX design, creativity, responsiveness, and code quality.
The final project must reflect the team's own design and implementation work.

rounds.name: Round 1: Responsive Landing Page
rounds.desc: Design a pixel-perfect hero and feature section on given theme.

rounds.name: Round 2: AI Prompt Integration & Full UI
rounds.desc: Complete interactive web application with generated UI assets.

guidelines: VS Code and standard browsers will be pre-installed.

name: UI/UX
subtitle: Digital Prototype & Experience Design
description: Design intuitive, modern digital interfaces and user experiences using industry-standard design tools.
rules: Systems will be provided for all the participants.
The theme or topic will be announced on the spot; AI tools are strictly restricted.
Participants can use any design software (e.g., Canva, Figma).
Round 1 is for designing the login page, Round 2 is for designing the dashboard.
It should be designed and submitted within the time limit.
Designs are judged on creativity, visual appeal, and relevance to the theme.

rounds.name: Round 1: Auth & Onboarding Flow
rounds.desc: Design smooth login, registration, and onboarding screens.

rounds.name: Round 2: Feature Dashboard & Interactions
rounds.desc: Create main dashboard UI with interactive prototypes.

guidelines: Participants can bring their own laptops with Figma installed.

name: SNAP & REEL
subtitle: Frames & Cinematic Shots
description: Capture cinematic campus moments, dynamic event energy, and craft creative 30-60 second Instagram reels.
rules: Create content based on the theme announced on the spot.
Photos and reels must be captured on campus on the event day.
Submit one photo and one reel (max. 60s); basic editing is allowed.
Entries must be original and submitted to the given email within the deadline.
Avoid restricted areas and disturbances; content must be suitable for all.
Judging will be based on creativity, theme relevance, originality, and presentation.

rounds.name: Campus Capture
rounds.desc: Shoot footage across symposium events.

rounds.name: Editing & Reel Submission
rounds.desc: Final color grading, sound mixing, and upload.

guidelines: Submission via Google Drive link or designated upload portal.

name: LINK UP (CONNECTION)
subtitle: Find The Hidden Link
description: Decode visual rebus puzzles, connected clues, movie scenes, and pop-culture links with fast buzzer reflexes.
rules: The quiz will be conducted in teams through multiple rounds.
Each question will appear on the screen for a fixed duration.
Responses must be submitted within the time specified by the organizers.
No electronic devices, internet access, or outside assistance are permitted.
Teams will be shortlisted based on their performance in each round.
The highest-scoring team at the end of the quiz will be declared as the winner.

rounds.name: Round 1: Picture Rebus Clues
rounds.desc: Solve interconnected images to find movie or word titles.

rounds.name: Round 2: Rapid Buzzer Connection
rounds.desc: Complex multi-stage connection puzzles with countdown timer.

guidelines: Decisions of the quizmaster are final and binding.

name: HUNT ZONE (TREASURE HUNT)
subtitle: Quest of The Ancients
description: An exciting treasure hunt across the campus uncovering riddles, cryptographic clues, and physical tokens.
rules: Teams must follow a series of clues to reach the final destination.
All clues will be placed within the designated college campus areas.
Clues should be solved in sequence without skipping any stage.
Online maps, external resources, and non-team assistance are not allowed.
Participants must respect campus property and avoid restricted zones.
The first team to reach the final destination with all required proofs wins.

rounds.name: Checkpoint 1: The Cryptic Trail
rounds.desc: Solve opening riddles to locate quadrant beacons.

rounds.name: Checkpoint 2: The Final Relic Vault
rounds.desc: Race to unlock the cipher box on the central quad.

guidelines: Wear comfortable athletic shoes for campus navigation.

name: HENNA HEIST
subtitle: Henna Art & Elegance
description: Display traditional Indian and Arabic henna patterns with intricacy, neatness, and artistic flair.
rules: Participants must bring their own mehendi cones and a person to apply the design on.
A theme will be announced on the spot with a fixed time limit.
Design one side of one hand, from fingertips to wrist.
Designs must be original and freehand; no stencils or reference images.
Glitter and decorative materials are not allowed.
Judging: creativity, neatness, intricacy & theme relevance.
Judges' decision is final.

rounds.name: Single Artistry Round
rounds.desc: Live henna application on partner/volunteer hand.

guidelines: Arrive 10 minutes prior with your volunteer/partner.

name: BATTLE OF CHAMPIONS (E-SPORTS)
subtitle: Mobile Battle Royale Showdown
description: High-stakes squad battle royale competition in Free Fire / BGMI on custom symposium rooms.
rules: Battle Royale – Squad mode with 4 players per team.
Mobile devices only; iPads allowed for BGMI. PCs and emulators are prohibited.
Players must use registered in-game names and join the custom room on time.
Cheating, hacking, or third-party software will lead to disqualification.
Disconnections, abusive language, and misconduct will not be entertained.
Scoring is based on placement and kills; organizers' decision is final.

rounds.name: Match 1: Bermuda / Erangel Qualifying Drop
rounds.desc: Survival and kill points bracket ranking.

rounds.name: Match 2: Purgatory / Miramar Finals
rounds.desc: Top seeded squads battle for the championship trophy.

guidelines: Bring fully charged mobile devices and personal headphones.

name: 64 SQUARES
subtitle: Grandmaster Board Tactics
description: FIDE-timed blitz chess tournament testing deep positional play, tactical vision, and endgame nerve.
rules: Blitz format with a fixed time limit per player.
Standard FIDE rules, including touch-move, apply.
Opponents will be assigned by the organizers.
Phones, smartwatches, and electronic devices are prohibited.
Ties will be decided through a tie-breaker round.
Good sportsmanship is expected; the arbiter's decision is final.

rounds.name: Round 1: Swiss / Knockout Prelims
rounds.desc: Preliminary matches to seed into the championship bracket.

rounds.name: Round 2: Quarter, Semi & Grand Finals
rounds.desc: Direct elimination knockout matches under digital clocks.

guidelines: Chess boards, pieces, and digital clocks provided.

name: BATTLEWORLD BIDDING
subtitle: Bid. Think. Win.
description: Step into the world of strategy, wit, and quick decisions. Bid smart, outthink the rest, and take the win!
rules: Strictly a team of 5 members.
Registration fee: ₹250 per team.
Virtual purse budget will be allocated to each participating team at the start.
Bidding follows sequential live auction rounds with strict countdown timers.
Exceeding allocated purse budget or bid collusion will result in penalty or disqualification.
Scoring is calculated from total squad/asset valuation, strategic diversity, and remaining funds.
Decision of the Auctioneer and judges is final and binding.

rounds.name: Purse Allocation & Rules Brief
rounds.desc: Rules explanation, category tier reveal, and budget distribution.

rounds.name: Live Auction Bidding
rounds.desc: Fast-paced live bidding rounds across featured player/asset pools.

guidelines: Paper and calculators will be provided for tracking bids.
Keep your bidding paddle clearly visible when placing bids.
Virtual purse ledger will be maintained by auction marshals.
